purpose: Minimal Topview task state: active task IDs per Scene plus a bounded processed-task journal for deduplication. Detailed attempt/queue/ETA history is intentionally not persistent.
authority: Operational telemetry/dedup only. Google Drive video-prompts.md remains canonical for Scene IDs, editorial state and slow membership.
rules: Scene ID identifies the creative scene; Topview task ID identifies one render attempt.
A rerun/rerender of an existing scene keeps the same Scene ID.
Known set = all active task IDs + processed_tasks task IDs.
A scene is Topview-slow while at least one known active task for that scene is init/queued/running/processing.
When the last Topview-managed active task for a scene reaches a terminal state, remove that scene from canonical slow; do not change approval/editorial state.
Keep only minimal processed-task facts needed for dedup/statistics: task_id, scene_id, final_status, finished_at. Do not persist queue/ETA history.
New Scene ID is created only for a genuinely new creative scene; ambiguity requires user review.

retention.note: Keep the most recent 200 processed tasks; older entries may be dropped after they are outside the recent Topview scan window.
